archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Adapted for Premium Corporate Banking)

global_rules.logic_constraint: CRITICAL: Do not change internal logic, state management, API calls, or props. Only modify CSS classes and minor markup within existing components.
global_rules.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

primary.description: Deep blue, main brand color (BBVA style)

secondary.description: Corporate secondary blue for headers and active states

accent.description: Bright blue for primary CTA buttons

background.description: Clean white and elegant light gray for surfaces

text.description: Deep blue for headings, pro gray for body text

status.description: Status colors for badges and alerts. Soft green for confirmations, elegant red for alerts.

layout.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8 for cards.
layout.border_radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-lg for buttons. Soft, modern.

buttons.primary: bg-[#1973B8] text-white hover:bg-[#004481] transition-colors rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 font-medium shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-0.5 transform duration-200
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#004481] border border-[#004481] hover:bg-[#F4F6F8] transition-colors rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 font-medium
buttons.danger: bg-white text-red-600 border border-red-200 hover:bg-red-50 transition-colors rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 font-medium

cards.base: bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-100 shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] p-6 transition-shadow hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)]

animations.counter: Use framer-motion useSpring for balance numbers
animations.hover: Smooth transform on buttons and cards

login_background.description: Modern corporate building interior for login page background

implementation_plan: Phase 1: Foundation. Update tailwind.config.js with the new color palette. Add global CSS variables in index.css.
Phase 2: Layout & Navigation. Update the Sidebar and Header to the light theme, using white background and deep blue active states.
Phase 3: Dashboard. Restructure KPI cards (Saldo, Capital, Retenidos) to use the new card design with soft shadows and animated counters.
Phase 4: Critical Pages. Update Withdrawal Management Panel, applying the 6 status badges. Update Client Profile and KYC flows.
Phase 5: Polish. Ensure mobile responsiveness, hover effects, loaders, and test all interactions.
